newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo leadership agree on direction - Gyll.
newsitem.headline: Volvo leadership agree on direction - Gyll.

text.p: The management of Swedish vehicle manufacturer AB Volvo is in complete agreement on strategic direction, outgoing chief executive Soren Gyll said on Monday.
"The management are more in agreement than ever over direction," Gyll told a news conference.
He said there had been some differences of opinion about Volvo's strategy.
"You can not change a company of Volvo's size without someone not liking it so much. One can expect that," Gyll said.
Gyll is resigning as chief executive and president at the end of April after five years to be replaced by head of Electrolux, Leif Johansson.
